verdict.rationale: TruffleHog documents a choice between hosted scanners (managed by Truffle Security) and self-hosted scanners (running in your environment), which gives some control over where scanning happens. The evidence only covers scanner deployment location, not where findings data is stored, and there is no region selection. Missing for 10: explicit data-residency or region selection for stored findings, documentation of where web-UI findings data lives with self-hosted scanners, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)

citations.quote: Choose hosted (managed by Truffle Security) or self-hosted (running in your environment).
Deploy hosted or self-hosted scanners, scan your critical systems for secrets
